core_obligations: Assume X is an algebraic stack (resp. DM); conclude Y is a stack in groupoids via the Stacks lemma and choose an equivalence f: X -> Y.
The 2-commutative square with equivalences f and f x f transfers representability of the diagonal to Delta_Y.
Transfer the surjective smooth (resp. etale) presentation x to f o x via the property-transfer lemma.
Converse direction: the statement is symmetric in X and Y, so rerun the same argument with roles exchanged.
proof_roadmap: Stack property transfer; diagonal transfer along the equivalence square; presentation transfer; converse by symmetry.
difficulty_reason: Two genuine transfer arguments (diagonal and presentation) plus a symmetric converse.
